verses.text: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, clear as crystal. It flowed from the throne of God and of the Lamb,

down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, which bears twelve kinds of fruit, a new crop every month. The leaves of the tree are for healing the nations.
There will no longer be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.
They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will give them light. And they will rule forever and ever.
The angel said to me, "These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God who gives his Spirit to the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants what must happen soon."
"Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who obeys the words of the prophecy in this book."
I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown them to me.
But he said to me, "Do not do that! I am a servant like you, and like your brothers the prophets, and like all who obey the words of this book. Worship God!"
Then he told me, "Do not keep the words of the prophecy in this book secret, because the time is near.
Let the one who does wrong keep on doing wrong. Let the one who is filthy keep on being filthy. Let the one who does right keep on doing right. Let the one who is holy keep on being holy."
"Look, I am coming soon! I bring my reward with me, to pay back each person for what he has done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Blessed are those who obey his commands, so that they have the right to the tree of life and can go through the gates into the city.
Outside are the dogs, those who practise witchcraft, those who do sexual sin, the murderers, those who worship idols, and everyone who loves and tells lies.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the root and the family of David, the bright morning star."
The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Let anyone who hears say, "Come!" Let anyone who is thirsty come. Let anyone who wants it take the water of life for free.
I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy in this book: if anyone adds anything to them, God will add to him the disasters written in this book.
And if anyone takes away any words from this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are written about in this book.
The one who tells these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all God's people. Amen.
